user_agreements.content:
# Research Grant Program Terms of Service

**Effective Date:** January 1, 2025

## 1. Eligibility

Grants are available to:
- Accredited academic institutions
- Research organizations with non-profit status
- Government research agencies

## 2. Proposal Requirements

- Clear scientific objectives and methodology
- Detailed resource justification
- Team qualifications and roles
- Timeline and milestones
- Budget breakdown

## 3. Review Process

All proposals undergo:
- Administrative compliance check
- Technical feasibility review
- Scientific merit peer review
- Resource allocation assessment

## 4. Award Conditions

- Resources must be used for stated purposes
- Progress reports required quarterly
- Publications must acknowledge funding
- Unused allocations may be reclaimed

## 5. Intellectual Property

- Grantees retain IP rights
- Open access publication encouraged
- Data sharing requirements apply

## 6. Compliance

- Adhere to ethical research guidelines
- Follow data protection regulations
- Report any misconduct immediately

# Research Grant Program Privacy Policy

**Last Updated:** January 1, 2025

## 1. Information We Collect

### Applicant Information
- Names, affiliations, and contact details
- Research credentials and publications
- Institutional information

### Proposal Data
- Research descriptions and methodologies
- Resource requests and justifications
- Team composition and roles

### Review Data
- Reviewer assignments and evaluations
- Scores and comments
- Decision records

## 2. How We Use Information

- Process and evaluate proposals
- Assign appropriate reviewers
- Track resource allocations
- Generate anonymized statistics
- Communicate decisions and updates

## 3. Information Sharing

- Reviewers see relevant proposal sections
- Anonymized data shared in reports
- Required disclosures to oversight bodies

## 4. Data Retention

- Active proposals: Duration of program
- Completed proposals: 7 years
- Review records: 5 years

## 5. Your Rights

You may request:
- Access to your data
- Correction of errors
- Withdrawal of application

## 6. Contact

Data Protection: privacy@research-council.edu

checklists.description: Mandatory compliance checklist covering research ethics, human subjects protection, and data handling requirements for proposal submissions.

checklists.description: Administrative compliance checklist verifying institutional eligibility, funding rules, and conformance with grant program requirements.

checklists.description: Structured technical feasibility assessment completed by the responsible role during the technical_assessment workflow step.

questions.description: Does your research involve human subjects?
questions.user_guidance: Human subjects include any living individual about whom an investigator obtains data through intervention or interaction, or identifiable private information.

questions.description: Have you obtained ethics committee/IRB approval?
questions.user_guidance: Provide documentation of ethics approval from your institutional review board or ethics committee.

questions.description: Upload ethics approval documentation
questions.user_guidance: Upload a copy of your ethics approval certificate or letter. Accepted formats: PDF, DOC, DOCX.

questions.description: What types of personal data will your research process?
questions.user_guidance: Select all categories of personal data that will be collected, processed, or stored during your research.

questions.description: Describe your data protection and security measures
questions.user_guidance: Describe encryption methods, access controls, data storage locations, and data retention policies.

questions.description: Will personal data be transferred outside the EU/EEA?
questions.user_guidance: International data transfers require specific legal safeguards under GDPR.

questions.description: Legal basis for international data transfer
questions.user_guidance: Select the legal mechanism that authorizes the international data transfer.

questions.description: What type of institution is the applicant organization?
questions.user_guidance: Select the category that best describes your organization.

questions.description: Is your institution located in an eligible country?
questions.user_guidance: Eligible countries include EU member states, EEA countries, and associated countries. Check the call documentation for the full list.

questions.description: Specify the country where your institution is located
questions.user_guidance: If your country is not in the eligible list, provide the country name for review.

questions.description: Year your institution was established
questions.user_guidance: Enter the founding year of your institution (e.g., 1950).

questions.description: When did your institution receive its current accreditation?
questions.user_guidance: Provide the date when your institution received its most recent official accreditation or recognition.

questions.description: Upload institutional registration or accreditation certificate
questions.user_guidance: Upload official documentation proving your institution's legal status. Accepted formats: PDF, DOC, DOCX.

questions.description: Do you have existing funding for this research from other sources?
questions.user_guidance: Disclose any current or pending funding for the same or overlapping research activities.

questions.description: Specify existing funding sources and amounts
questions.user_guidance: List all current and pending funding sources, including grant numbers, amounts, and funding periods.

questions.description: Which research areas does this proposal cover?
questions.user_guidance: Select all applicable research domains for your proposal.

questions.description: Have you submitted this proposal or substantially similar work to other funding programs?
questions.user_guidance: Dual submissions may be prohibited or require disclosure depending on program rules.

questions.description: List other submissions (program name, date, status)
questions.user_guidance: Provide details of any other submissions including program name, submission date, and current status.

questions.description: Upload supporting documents for your application
questions.user_guidance: Upload any additional documentation supporting your eligibility (letters of support, collaboration agreements, etc.).

questions.description: I confirm that the applicant organization and all key personnel meet the eligibility criteria specified in the call documentation
questions.user_guidance: By checking this box, you certify that you have reviewed the eligibility requirements and confirm compliance.

questions.description: Technical feasibility decision
questions.user_guidance: Assess whether the requested resources and technical approach are feasible for this proposal.

questions.description: Assessment rationale
questions.user_guidance: Explain the reasoning behind the feasibility decision.

proposals.name: Quantum Error Correction Simulations
proposals.description: This research program will develop and implement novel quantum error correction codes optimized for near-term quantum hardware. Using large-scale HPC simulations, we will benchmark these codes against current state-of-the-art approaches and identify promising candidates for experimental implementation.
proposals.project_summary: This proposal requests HPC resources for large-scale quantum error correction code simulations. We aim to develop and benchmark novel quantum error correction codes that can be implemented on near-term quantum hardware. Our team combines expertise in quantum computing theory, numerical simulation methods, and experimental quantum physics.
proposals._team_comment: PI: Niels Bohr (quantum theory), Co-PI: Project Manager (simulation expertise), Team Member: Project Member (data analysis)

proposals.name: Novel Battery Materials Discovery
proposals.description: We will employ high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) calculations combined with machine learning models to screen thousands of candidate materials for next-generation lithium-ion and solid-state batteries. This computational approach significantly accelerates the materials discovery process compared to experimental trial-and-error methods.
proposals.project_summary: We propose to use high-throughput computational screening to discover new battery electrode materials. Our approach combines DFT calculations with machine learning to accelerate the discovery process. The interdisciplinary team includes computational chemists, materials scientists, and machine learning experts.
proposals._team_comment: PI: Linus Pauling (materials chemistry), Co-I: Rachel Carson (data modeling)

proposals.name: Global Climate Model Enhancement
proposals.description: Our project will implement adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) techniques in global climate models to achieve unprecedented resolution in critical regions such as mountain ranges, coastlines, and urban areas. This will enable more accurate predictions of extreme weather events and regional climate impacts.
proposals.project_summary: This project aims to enhance global climate model resolution using adaptive mesh refinement techniques. We will focus on improving precipitation predictions in mountainous regions. The team includes climate scientists, numerical methods specialists, and HPC software engineers.
proposals._team_comment: PI: Rachel Carson (climate science), Team: 2 postdocs (not yet in system)

proposals.name: Large Language Model Fine-tuning
proposals.project_summary: We request GPU resources to fine-tune large language models for scientific text understanding. The models will be optimized for extracting structured information from research papers.

proposals.name: Protein Structure Prediction
proposals.project_summary: This proposal focuses on using deep learning methods for protein structure prediction. We will develop and train neural networks to predict 3D protein structures from amino acid sequences.

proposals.name: Molecular Dynamics of Membrane Proteins
proposals.project_summary: We propose large-scale molecular dynamics simulations of membrane protein complexes. This work will provide insights into drug binding mechanisms and membrane transport.
proposals.allocation_comment: Excellent proposal with strong scientific merit

proposals.name: Weather Prediction Neural Network
proposals.project_summary: Training neural networks for short-term weather prediction using historical data.

proposals.name: Particle Physics Event Simulation
proposals.project_summary: Monte Carlo simulation of particle physics events for LHC data analysis.
proposals.allocation_comment: Strong track record and clear methodology

proposals.name: Computational Fluid Dynamics Study
proposals.project_summary: CFD simulations for aerodynamic optimization of wind turbine blades.
proposals.allocation_comment: Important application with clear industrial impact

proposals.name: Genomic Data Analysis Pipeline
proposals.project_summary: Development of genomic analysis pipeline for population genetics studies.

proposals.name: Drug Discovery AI Platform
proposals.project_summary: AI-powered platform for virtual screening of drug candidates.

proposals.name: Astrophysical Simulation Project
proposals.project_summary: N-body simulations of galaxy formation and evolution.

proposals.name: Exascale Turbulence Simulation
proposals.project_summary: Direct numerical simulation of compressible turbulence at exascale to resolve the fine-scale energy cascade; awaiting the applicant's award response before provisioning.

proposals.name: Cryo-EM Density Map Refinement
proposals.project_summary: GPU-accelerated cryo-EM density map refinement; currently at technical assessment awaiting the responsible role to complete the required feasibility checklist.

proposals.name: Photonic Quantum Networking
proposals.project_summary: Design and simulation of a metropolitan-scale photonic quantum network; all evaluation steps complete, awaiting the allocation decision.

proposals.name: Fusion Plasma Turbulence Modeling
proposals.project_summary: High-fidelity gyrokinetic modeling of fusion plasma turbulence; technical assessment in progress with the feasibility checklist completed.

proposals.name: Topological Qubit Braiding Simulations
proposals.description: We simulate braiding operations on Majorana-based topological qubits with tensor-network methods, sweeping disorder and temperature to map the regime where topological protection holds. The results feed the design of the next generation of hybrid superconductor-semiconductor devices.
proposals.project_summary: Tensor-network simulations of non-abelian anyon braiding to estimate gate fidelities of topological qubits under realistic noise.

proposals.name: Variational Quantum Eigensolver Benchmarks
proposals.description: The project emulates variational quantum eigensolver runs for a benchmark set of small molecules, comparing hardware-efficient and chemistry-inspired ansaetze under shot noise. The emulator runs state-vector simulations across many nodes.
proposals.project_summary: Classical emulation of variational quantum eigensolvers on molecules of up to 40 qubits to benchmark ansatz families and optimisers.

proposals.name: Perovskite Solar Cell Screening
proposals.description: We screen several thousand lead-free halide perovskite compositions with hybrid-functional DFT, ranking them by band gap, defect tolerance and thermodynamic stability, and pass the best candidates to experimental partners.
proposals.project_summary: High-throughput DFT screening of lead-free halide perovskites for stable, efficient solar absorbers.

proposals.name: Quantum Annealing for Protein Folding
proposals.description: We formulate lattice protein folding as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimisation problem, embed it onto annealer topologies and validate the solutions with parallel tempering on classical hardware.
proposals.project_summary: Mapping coarse-grained protein folding onto quantum annealing hardware, with large classical simulations to validate the embeddings.

proposals.name: Lattice QCD at the Physical Point
proposals.description: We generate gauge ensembles at the physical pion mass on fine lattices and compute hadronic vacuum polarisation with GPU-accelerated solvers.
proposals.project_summary: Lattice QCD ensembles at physical quark masses for precision hadronic contributions to the muon anomalous magnetic moment.

proposals.name: Quantum Many-Body Dynamics with Neural States
proposals.description: We train neural-network wave functions with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo to follow quench dynamics in 2D spin lattices beyond the reach of exact methods.
proposals.project_summary: Neural-network quantum states for the real-time dynamics of two-dimensional spin systems after a quench.

proposals.name: Solid-State Electrolyte Molecular Dynamics
proposals.description: We train machine-learned potentials on DFT data and run microsecond molecular dynamics to resolve lithium transport pathways in sulfide electrolytes.
proposals.project_summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials for ion transport in sulfide solid-state electrolytes.

proposals.name: Convection-Permitting Regional Climate Ensemble
proposals.description: We run a convection-permitting regional climate ensemble at 2.5 km resolution to quantify changes in sub-daily precipitation extremes under different warming levels.
proposals.project_summary: A kilometre-scale regional climate ensemble over Europe for extreme precipitation statistics.

proposals.name: Quantum Chemistry of Nitrogenase Cofactors
proposals.description: We apply DMRG-based multireference methods to the FeMo cofactor to resolve its electronic structure along the nitrogen reduction pathway.
proposals.project_summary: Multireference quantum chemistry of the FeMo cofactor of nitrogenase; awarded, waiting for the applicant to accept the award.

proposals.name: Exascale Turbulence in Stellar Convection
proposals.description: We run fully compressible simulations of stellar convection zones at resolutions where the turbulent cascade is resolved, on CPUs for the hydrodynamics and on GPUs for radiative transfer.
proposals.project_summary: Resolved-turbulence simulations of stellar convection; at the technical assessment of both partitions.
